chooseResponse.q: What's the best way to study for finals?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Hey, have you started studying for finals?
Advisor: Yes, I have. I joined a study group. How about you?
Student: Not yet. I’m feeling a bit overwhelmed.
Advisor: That’s understandable. Maybe you should consider joining a group too.

questions.explain: 學生表示感到不知所措。
顧問建議加入學習小組。

announcement.transcript: Attention students! The library will extend its hours during finals week. It will remain open until midnight from Monday to Thursday. Don't miss this opportunity to study in a quieter environment!

questions.q: When will the library stay open late?
questions.explain: 圖書館週一到週四將延長開放時間。

questions.q: Why is the library extending its hours?
questions.explain: 圖書館延長開放時間是為了幫助學生學習。

talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss renewable energy sources. Renewable energy is derived from natural processes that are replenished constantly. Examples include solar power, wind energy, and hydropower. These resources are sustainable and can significantly reduce our reliance on fossil fuels. Transitioning to renewable energy not only helps mitigate climate change but also promotes energy security and job creation in new industries. As technology advances, the efficiency and affordability of these sources continue to improve, making them more accessible for widespread use.

questions.q: What is renewable energy sourced from?
questions.explain: 可再生能源來自自然過程。

questions.q: What is one advantage of renewable energy?
options: It is more expensive than fossil fuels
questions.explain: 可再生能源的優點之一是有助於減緩氣候變化。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a renewable energy source?
questions.explain: 天然氣不是可再生能源。

questions.q: How is the efficiency of renewable energy improving?
questions.explain: 可再生能源的效率透過技術進步而改善。
